rules.alternatives: For active renewal the nurse shows one of: 1,000 hours of nursing practice in the last 5 years; completion of a board-approved nursing diploma/degree program in the last 5 years; or 30 CEUs earned in the 2 years before renewal (15 CEUs per qualifying college semester hour). Otherwise a board-approved refresher or preceptorship program is required.
rules.accepted_credit_types: CEUs awarded or approved by AHEC, ANA, ANCC, MNA, NCSBN, NLN, APRN certification bodies or a local/state/national professional nursing association
rules.carryover: CEUs cannot be carried into the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: CEUs used for renewal are subject to random audit; keep proof 6 years after renewal and produce it within 30 days of a request.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal by the 28th of the birth month: odd birth year renews in odd years, even birth year in even years. Practice hours include teaching, supervision and administration.
rules.rule_quote: (1) An individual applying for active licensure renewal shall show evidence of: (a) 1,000 hours of active nursing practice within the 5 years immediately preceding the date of the renewal application;…
